title: Vagrantsong
subtitle: A haunting boss-battler campaign aboard a supernatural ghost train
tagline: Restore lost souls or ride the rails forever
loreSummary: You are vagrants trapped on a cursed ghost train, surrounded by tortured spirits called haints. Only by uncovering the humanity buried within each lost soul can you hope to find your way off the train.
keyFeatures: Unique boss encounters — each haint has special mechanics and narrative
Camp Phase progression — heal, upgrade skills, and prepare between sessions
Coin-driven action economy — spend coins to move, investigate, and attack
Restore humanity instead of simply defeating bosses — a twist on the genre
Atmospheric Southern Gothic horror theme with striking art style

vagrantsong_core.name: Core Campaign (3 Chapters)
vagrantsong_core.description: The full base game campaign across all three chapters, battling each of the haunted train cars' bosses and uncovering the ghost train's dark secret.

vagrantsong_standard.name: Standard Run with Side Stories
vagrantsong_standard.description: Core campaign plus additional in-between camp story cards and optional encounters that enrich the narrative between major boss encounters.

vagrantsong_encore.name: Encore Expansion (Full Journey)
vagrantsong_encore.description: The complete experience combining the base game campaign with the Encore expansion's second campaign — a full-length supernatural odyssey from boarding to final escape.

milestones.title: The First Stop
milestones.phase: Chapter One – Boarding the Ghost Train
milestones.description: Your vagrants have survived their first encounters on the cursed train, beginning to understand the nature of the haints and the strange power of humanity.

milestones.title: Deep into the Darkness
milestones.phase: Chapter Two – Into the Heart of the Train
milestones.description: The train's secrets grow darker as your vagrants press deeper, facing increasingly powerful haints and uncovering the truth behind the supernatural journey.

milestones.title: The Final Reckoning
milestones.description: All paths converge as your vagrants face the ultimate confrontation that will determine whether they can restore enough humanity to escape the ghost train forever.
